posts.name: pwatson1974
posts.cooked:
Advanced Bomber Blade vs Greatest Legacy, Prime Wardens Fanatic, Dark Visionary and Freedom Five Wraith in Insula Primalis.

Mint. As its advanced, this is Bomber Blade on steroids. You will lose all your set up so just pound him into submission and hope Visionary gets her trash cotrols at a point where she can used them without dying (or where Blade will be low enough than her dying still allows the win). Might be worth End of Daying to get rid of both of his Froce fields if it won’t slow down your damage too much, although I won without this strategy.

posts.name: Reverend Pete
posts.cooked:
Mint.

 

Just went for as much damage as possible, and used Visionary to keep the Hasten Dooms away... I spammed Fanatic's base power using Legacy, not really caring how much damage she took, and that allowed Legacy and Fanatic to beat on Blade pretty hard. Wresting the Minds of the dinosaurs was a big aid, too.

 

A well-timed Heroic Interception near the end saved the heroes from massive Death Ray blasts. Fanatic ended it with Sacrosacnt Martyr.

 

This was a rare game for me where Wraith didn't participate much... she sort of felt like an innocent bystander.

 

Legacy 7HP, Fanatic 2HP, Visionary 15HP and Wraith 13HP.

posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
Blackfang108:

Question: why does End of Days remove cards from under the dreamer, but not from under Bomber Blade?

Because destroying ALL cards other than Indestructible, Relics or Character cards is what End of Days does, doesn't matter where they are or what side up they are, End of Days destroys them.

However, Bomber Blade specifically says  "Whenever a Villain Target enters play, put it under this card and play the top card of the Villain deck. Cards under this card have no game text, are indestructible, and are not considered in play." The Dreamer does not have any text like this.

 

EDIT: Curse you Powerhound_2000!

posts.name: starkenburg_alexander
posts.cooked:
Mint with everyone near 10.

Advanced mode mean Baron Blade moves too fast to do anything but burn him down asap, which is what I did.

Used Legacy's power on himself to charge every round, healing everyone a bit from the AoE damage and Legacy more to counteract the Nemesis bonus. Ended up with BB getting one last turn on his front with 1 hp left, which meant 7 damage to everyone, but oh well. After he killed all my equipment/ongoings anyway, I just EoD'ed his two forcefields away and commenced beat-down number 2. Throat Jab and Heroic Interception kept the worst of his damage at bay, and mind controlled T-Rexes took big chomps out of him. Ended with a Brutal Censure when Legacy couldnt quite get the nemesis ending.

 

~Komori

posts.name: Gus_Smedstad
posts.cooked:
Mint.

Mostly went for pure damage. Twist the Aether reduced damage from Bomber side baron. After the flip Divergence let Visionary destroy living force fields and regain useful ongoings like Twist the Aether. After the flip Legacy got Next Evolution, which effectively neutralized the Baron’s death ray. That plus Twist the Aether meant not only was Legacy immune to energy, all of the Baron’s attacks were energy (even Hasten Doom). Danger Sense meant Legacy could safely taunt the T-Rexes, and Smoke Bombs let me redirect a lot of damage to Legacy where he’d laugh it off due to Next Evolution.

Still, it wasn’t quite easy, since everyone was down to about 6 HP each at the end.

posts.name: QuirkyDM
posts.cooked:
Mint.

Both End of Days in Fanatic's hand meant I could use Fanatic's power without negative consequences, so I used it every turn. All extra power plays went to Legacy to double dip on Motivational Charge each round. Twist the Ether went on Fanatic for extra damage since she pulled an early Divine Focus, but it likely would have gone better on Legacy.

Consecrated Ground took out the first force field and I never saw the second one. Blade went down at the end of the 2nd round and when the first T-Rex came out, Blade was tied for first and so he got chomped. Just over one round later, and Legacy finished him off for good. I played pure offence every turn and the game never came down to the wire.
